causality_contract.availability_rule: absorption uses 1m windows ending at bar close with trailing medians from strictly prior windows; displacement uses bars <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored

direction: displacement direction following the absorption bar

entry.rule: signal at displacement bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = displacement bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: 1m bar with window volume >= 3x trailing-20-window median AND price range <= 0.25x trailing median range (absorption form), followed within 3 bars by same-resolution displacement (range > 2x ATR14); direction = displacement direction.
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
invalidation: No displacement within 3 bars, or displacement against the absorption extreme.
mechanism: High-volume stasis indicates two-sided absorption; the subsequent displacement shows which side resolved it.
research_question: Does trade-based absorption followed by displacement predict continuation?
threshold_provenance: 3.0x/0.25x/20-window absorption form = frozen 11G-J definitional form (untuned). Displacement 2xATR = certified. Confirmation 3 bars = frozen 11G sweep-window convention.
